name: location_node
description: GH #3501 / REQ-625, decisions 0050 D1 and 0057 D1. One tree of warehouse locations: node_kind is site, zone or address. parent_id is the record_id of the parent location_node (a declarative string, absent for a site); the parent-kind rule and cycle absence are not enforced. org_site_id is the record_id of an org_site, not validated. address is the scannable label, unique per tenant, optional. active false retires the record, there is no delete operation. external_ref_system and external_ref_id are the nullable import key (0057 D1).
